cards.card_text: True or false: if a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, only the man has to bathe.
cards.verse_text: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, both must bathe with water, and they will remain unclean until evening.

cards.card_text: True or false: if a man lies with a woman during her period and her flow touches him, he is unclean only until evening.
cards.verse_text: If a man lies with her and her menstrual flow touches him, he will be unclean for seven days, and any bed on which he lies will become unclean.
